subject: Mutual action plan, decision committee, and exec review scheduling
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Truong <sarah.truong@lumahealth.com>, Ankit Sharma <ankit@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and decision committee

Hi Sarah / Ankit —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposed MAP to keep alignment as we move toward the evaluation readout / exec decision:

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use case: streamline patient reminders and reduce no-shows across multi-clinic workflows.
- Success metrics that matter to the committee: 15% reduction in no-shows within 8 weeks, average reminder deliverability > 98%, and zero PHI retention in hosted flows.
- Decision committee: Clinical Ops lead + IT security + Procurement + VP of Product (final approver).

Proposed MAP (attached: MAP-LumaHealth-v1.xlsx) — high level
1) Technical trial (2 weeks): Redwood-hosted sandbox, sample dataset ingestion, endpoint verification — owner: Jordan (AE) / Luma IT engagement.
2) Outcome measurement (4-week evaluation): run against pilot clinic cohort, Redwood provides metric dashboard and exportable logs — owner: Marissa (CS).
3) Security & compliance checks (parallel): complete questionnaire + evidence package — owner: Luma IT + Redwood security.
4) Executive readout & decision committee meeting: 30–45 minute slot where we present metrics and ask for go/no-go — target window: May 26–30.

Immediate asks
- Can you confirm the decision committee attendees and their preferred windows for May 26–30?
- Is procurement's standard PO/contract review timeline ~2 weeks after the exec slot? (I want to align our SOW schedule)
- Please confirm the three success criteria above or note modifications.

Attachments: MAP-LumaHealth-v1.xlsx (outline + owners + timeline)

If that looks good I'll update the MAP based on your notes and send a calendar invite with a tentative exec slot.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0179
From: Sarah Truong <sarah.truong@lumahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ankit Sharma <ankit@lumahealth.com>, Luma Health Procurement <procurement@lumahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and decision committee

Thanks Soojin — this is helpful and well-structured. A few clarifications from our side:  

Decision committee attendees (confirmed):
- Priya Menon, VP Product (final approver)
- Carlos Vega, Clinical Ops Lead
- Mina Patel, IT Security (will own the questionnaire)
- Procurement (cc'd) will join for contract questions but won't block the exec outcome.

Success criteria adjustments:
- Reduction in no-shows: we want to target 12% over 8 weeks (we're conservative on the first pass).
- Deliverability target stays 98%+.
- Data handling: we need an explicit statement that Redwood will not persist PHI in the hosted sandbox and that all exported logs are redacted; our security team will validate.

Timing notes from procurement (procurement@lumahealth.com):
- Procurement typically needs 10 business days for an initial order form review, 15 if there are custom legal terms.
- We'll need the security questionnaire filled and any SOC/attestation links prior to the exec slot if possible.

Attachments requested: security-questionnaire-Luma.pdf (attached) — can you return this with answers by EOD Thursday?

Available exec windows: May 27 (10:00–11:00 PT) or May 28 (14:00–15:00 PT). We prefer May 27 if you can accommodate.

Sarah
Sarah Truong | Head of Clinical Partnerships
Luma Health
sarah.truong@lumahealth.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Truong <sarah.truong@lumahealth.com>, Ankit Sharma <ankit@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Luma Health Procurement <procurement@lumahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and decision committee

Sarah — thanks for the quick clarifications, and noted on the procurement timeline. Answers & next steps below: 

1) Exec slot: We can hold May 27 10:00–11:00 PT. I'll tentatively block that and send an invite to the committee once we have the SOW timeline and the security Q answered.

2) Security questionnaire: attaching our responses (attachment: security-questionnaire-Luma.pdf — redlines and evidence links included). Our security team confirmed we will not persist PHI in the sandbox; logs will be redacted by default.

3) Adjusted success criteria (accepted):
- Target: 12% reduction in no-shows within 8 weeks (measurement window aligns with evaluation cohort).
- Deliverability > 98%.
- Zero PHI persistence in sandbox; redacted exports for metric dashboards.

4) Owners & timeline (updated MAP attached: MAP-LumaHealth-v1.xlsx)
- Jordan (AE) -> technical onboarding and test data ingest (completion target: May 21).
- Marissa (CS) -> evaluation metrics dashboard + runbook (completion target: May 24).
- Redwood Security -> evidence package and questionnaire (return EOD May 21).
- Luma Procurement -> initial contract review (10 business days after SOW submission).

5) Contract / SOW path: We'll prepare a brief SOW and order form and share it by May 21. If the committee signs off on May 27, procurement's 10-business-day review would push final execution into early June — we want to be explicit about that in the meeting. Draft SOW attached (SOW-draft-Luma-20260519.docx).

Next actions I will take today:
- Finalize and send the calendar invite for May 27 10:00 PT (tentative)
- Upload security questionnaire answers and the MAP to the shared Drive link and send here
- Jordan to run initial ingest with Luma IT tomorrow (May 20)

If that all looks right I’ll mark the tasks in the MAP as committed and share a short one‑pager for the exec.

Thanks —
Soojin
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Prep for Luma exec readout (May 27) — one-pager / pricing levers / demo highlights

Folks — looping you in on the Luma playbook. Exec readout tentatively May 27 10:00–11:00 PT. We need a tight packet for the decision committee. Please confirm ownership and deliverables below: 

Jordan (owner):
- Complete sandbox ingest and smoke tests by EOD May 20. 
- Share short runbook and a 5-min technical slide for the exec pack.

Marissa (owner):
- Finalize evaluation dashboard and the exportable CSV (metrics aligned to 12% no-show reduction) by May 24. Prepare 3 key charts (baseline vs week 4 & week 8).

Sean (owner - pricing lead):
- Prepare pricing levers and one-slide win/lose scenarios for the exec (including Dedicated vs Hosted price delta + typical committed volumes).
- Outline the proposed order form (we'll use the SOW draft attached) and flag any non-standard T&Cs we should negotiate before May 27.

Additional asks:
- Draft a one-pager (single PDF) that ties metrics to the ask: what decision the committee will make and the anticipated procurement path if they approve (Jordan + Marissa to co-author, Marissa to finalize).
- I'll own the exec slide deck + invite. Jordan, cc Luma IT during ingest and confirm dev access.

Risks to call out during the meeting: procurement timeline (10 biz days), security sign-off dependency, and potential data mapping delays if we need PHI redaction beyond our standard flow.

Attachments referenced for internal work: MAP-LumaHealth-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-Luma-20260519.docx, security-questionnaire-Luma.pdf

Please reply-all with acknowledgements and any blockers. I want the packet ready by COB May 24 so we can rehearse on May 26.

— Soojin
